title: Storage-Neutral Parent/Child Topology with agent-graph-store

claims.assertion: Hierarchical multi-agent topologies must be modeled with storage-neutral graph traits to cleanly support both ephemeral in-memory and persistent cloud backends

context: Managing parent-child agent delegations, spawn hierarchies, and edge lifecycle statuses creates tight coupling if tied directly to a concrete database schema.
distilled_learning: Implement a storage-neutral graph store abstraction (AgentGraphStore) with explicit thread spawn edge statuses (ThreadSpawnEdgeStatus) and async future boundaries, decoupling in-memory state from remote cloud persistence.
